variants.suspected_cause: The target selects the state byte into D0 with moveq branches and performs one common object-state store; the parent repeats the pointer load and immediate byte store in both arms.
variants.controlled_change: Rewrite only the three case-8 object-state if/else assignments as ternary-selected byte values assigned once.

predicted_effect.note: Each of three two-arm immediate byte stores is predicted to become two moveq instructions plus one common pointer load/store, reducing payload by about eight bytes per selection.
